reply_text:
㊥ (the other 象 files) Done. `futon-config.el` now requires `xiang-trace` and `xiaoxiang-preview` as well. All three files (including `turn-stepper`) are on the hot-reload list, so edits to them reload live during this session. Both are loaded in your Emacs now. Committed as `69af18f` in futon0 and pushed.

㊬ (checked)
- **Parentheses:** the check passes.
- **Loaded:** both features are loaded, and `xiang-trace` has attached its recorders. It enables itself once `session-turn-analysis` is loaded.
- **Hot reload:** the resolved hot-reload targets include all three files.

㊩ (a likely false alarm) When you switch the recorder back to `jvm`, `xiang-trace` may start reporting a violation. One of its rules is "reply end → dispatch", and it learns about dispatches by watching the Emacs function `session-mode--dispatch-analysis`. Under `jvm`, the JVM dispatches at send and Emacs never calls that function. So the lighter could show something like `!reply end → dispatch` while everything is fine. The fix is to have the JVM path record its own dispatch event: a small change in `session-turn-analysis.el`, which I can make if you see the warning.

🈳 (still open) The recorder is still `files` after the restart, so the fast path isn't in use. `(setq session-mode-turn-recorder 'jvm)` turns it back on. Once you've used it for a few turns, I'll measure the timing.
